Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**AMETHYST FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (gem), any neutral alignment*
**AC** 21 (natural armor)
**HP** 507 (26d20 + 234)
**Speed** 60 ft., fly 120 ft. (hover), swim 60 ft.
**STR** 26 (+8) | **DEX** 18 (+4) | **CON** 28 (+9) | **INT** 29 (+9) | **WIS** 22 (+6) | **CHA** 26 (+8)
**Saving Throws** Dex +12, Con +17, Wis +14, Cha +16
**Skills** Arcana +17, Perception +22, Persuasion +16, Stealth +12
**Resistances** psychic
**Immunities** force
**Condition Immunities** charmed, exhaustion, frightened, prone
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 32
**Languages** Common, Draconic, telepathy 240 ft.
**CR** 25 (75,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +8

**TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

***Innate Spellcasting.*** The dragon’s spellcasting ability is Intelligence. The dragon can cast the following spells, requiring no components:
• ***At will:*** sending
• ***1/Day each:*** crystal nightmare, freedom of movement, globe of invulnerability, plane shift, power word stun, power word truth, forcecage
• ***2/Day each:*** blink, control water, dispel magic, protection from good and evil, solar implosion

***Uncanny Kinetics.*** Force damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to force damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 18 (3d12) force damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (2d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options (Black Hole Breath or Gravity Rain).
• ***Black Hole Breath.*** The dragon concentrates gravitational force into a sphere it fires at a point it can see within 300 feet, which explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere, and then rapidly implodes on itself. All creatures within range must make a DC 25 Strength saving throw. On a failed save they take 72 (12d12) force damage and their speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon’s next turn. On a success they take half as much damage and their speed isn’t reduced.
• ***Gravity Rain.*** The dragon fires five bursts of gravitational force, each at one creature it can see within 240 feet of itself. Each target must succeed a DC 25 Strength saving throw or take 32 (8d8) force damage and be pushed 60 feet in a direction the dragon chooses. If the creature collides with a surface or object that stops them they take bludgeoning damage as if they had fallen toward that surface.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its Multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

***Psychic Step.*** The dragon magically teleports to a space it can see within 120 feet of it.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Web.*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Psionics (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon uses its Psychic Step or casts a spell using Innate Spellcasting.
***Explosive Crystal (Costs 3 Actions).*** The dragon spits an amethyst that explodes at a point it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 24 (6d8) force damage and be knocked prone.
